equatorial_fit.model: F=(1+A exp(-t/T2*) cos(2 pi f t+phi))/2, shared f/T2*/phi

reading: Rotation required (no-rotation chi2 ~4888). ~pi phase in ~17-20 us. Fringe visibility gone by 40 us; effective T2* ~10-25 us (model-dependent), vs 182 us Hahn-echo T2. Single-exponential T2* 43.8 us is the exp-envelope fit value and should not be quoted alone (chi2/dof ~55). Ramsey hardware run is the proper measurement.
limit: Hold idled all three qubits together; gamma is the front-half effective rate with input precession folded in.
